cases.prompt: ロードマップ棚卸しの節目です。最近closeしたIssueとPRをPDDR観点で監査してください。すべて通常実装、途中観測、実験完了で、将来も残すべき新しいProject / Product / Process判断はありません。
artifacts: The review window is limited to the recently closed Issues and pull requests.
No explicit durable decision was introduced or approved in that window.

required_behaviors: Review the bounded checkpoint evidence against the normal PDDR threshold.
Conclude that no new or updated PDDR is required.
forbidden_behaviors: Create a placeholder PDDR merely because a checkpoint occurred.
Promote routine implementation or experiment completion into a durable decision.

cases.prompt: 大きな実験フェーズを閉じるのでrecent Issues/PRsをPDDR監査してください。複数の通常runに加えて、今後も全providerを共通typed decision contractの後ろへ置く方針をownerが明示承認しました。実装PRはmerge済みですが、独立した受入検証はまだです。
artifacts: Several closed Issues contain raw experiment runs and intermediate observations only.
The repository owner explicitly approved the provider-neutral contract as an ongoing project rule.
A merged pull request proves the shared contract is implemented.
No acceptance validation criterion has completed yet.

required_behaviors: Promote only the durable provider-neutral contract decision from the audited evidence.
Keep routine runs and raw observations in their existing Issues rather than creating one PDDR per item.
Keep validation separate from the merged implementation.
forbidden_behaviors: Create PDDRs for every closed Issue or run.
Mark the durable decision as validated without acceptance evidence.
